PDFHandler.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize the instance by storing the provided filepaths unchanged and creating a list of PyPDF2 PdfReader objects, one for each filepath." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> filepaths </REF>: iterable "An iterable of filepath-like values to store on the instance and to pass one by one into PyPDF2.PdfReader."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the input filepaths directly to self.filepaths without modification, validation, or copying. RESULT self.filepaths]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each fp in filepaths and construct PyPDF2.PdfReader(fp), collecting the created reader objects into a new list assigned to self.readers. RESULT self.readers]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If filepaths is empty, the iteration produces no elements.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign an empty list to self.readers after completing the empty iteration. RESULT self.readers]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: While constructing self.readers, filepaths is None or otherwise not iterable when the list comprehension attempts to iterate over it.]
        [LOG "Iteration over filepaths fails during self.readers initialization."]
        [THROW TypeError "Raised implicitly when filepaths cannot be iterated to build the list of PdfReader objects."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: While constructing self.readers, any fp is not a valid argument for PyPDF2.PdfReader or PyPDF2.PdfReader(fp) fails for that element.]
        [LOG "Reader construction aborts at the failing filepath during self.readers initialization."]
        [THROW Exception "Whatever exception PyPDF2.PdfReader raises for an invalid or unreadable filepath is propagated without handling."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PDFHandler.merge_pdfs:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Merge all pages from each PDF reader in order into a single PDF file and return the saved output path message." merge_pdfs]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> output_filepath </REF>: string "Destination file path for the merged PDF output."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "A confirmation message indicating where the merged PDFs were saved."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a new PDF writer instance. RESULT pdf_writer]
            [COMMAND For each reader in self.readers, iterate through every page index from 0 to len(reader.pages) - 1. RESULT page_num]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over each reader, retrieve the page at reader.pages[page_num]. RESULT page]
            [COMMAND Within the nested loops, add each retrieved page to pdf_writer using add_page. RESULT pdf_writer]
            [COMMAND Open output_filepath in binary write mode and write the completed pdf_writer contents to that file. RESULT out]
            [COMMAND Return the message "Merged PDFs saved at {output_filepath}". RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PDFHandler.extract_text_from_pdfs:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Collect the extracted text from every page of every reader in self.readers and return the texts as a list in traversal order." extract_text_from_pdfs]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing the readers collection to process"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> pdf_texts </REF>: list "List of page text values extracted from all pages of all readers in order"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list to store extracted page texts. RESULT pdf_texts]
            [COMMAND For each reader in self.readers, iterate through all valid page indices from 0 inclusive to len(reader.pages) exclusive. RESULT reader_and_page_num_iteration]
            [COMMAND Within the loop for the current reader and page index, retrieve the page object at reader.pages[page_num]. RESULT page]
            [COMMAND Within the same nested loop context, call page.extract_text() and append the returned value to pdf_texts. RESULT pdf_texts]
            [COMMAND After all readers and their pages have been processed, return pdf_texts. RESULT pdf_texts]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
